# MDMX

> A git-native CMS toolkit for Next.js built on "MDMX": a strict,
> round-trippable subset of MDX where the user's own React components are
> first-class blocks in a Notion-style editor. Content is committed to the
> user's repo; a codegen step turns their components into a typed registry
> that drives validation, the editor palette, prop panels, and the public
> render. TypeScript, pnpm-workspaces monorepo, ESM.

Setup is convention-first: `mdmx init nextjs` scaffolds the app,
`createMDMXHandlers()` takes no arguments (structural values come from
`mdmx.config.json`, secrets from the environment, mode is detected and fails
closed in production), and `mdmx generate` writes the component maps and bound
server helpers into a committed `.mdmx/` directory.

Key invariants: canonical byte-stable serialization (changes are semver-major);
component props must be JSON literals; out-of-subset content is preserved
byte-for-byte via raw blocks; editing one prop changes one line of output.

Vocabulary: a *document* is any MDMX file (core's concern); an *entry* is a
document belonging to a collection (project/HTTP/dashboard vocabulary).

Agents: documentation is part of "done". After each session, follow the
wiki-upkeep checklist in AGENTS.md (append SessionLog, record ADRs, sync wiki).

## Packages

- [packages/core](packages/core): parser, validator (MDMX001–010), canonical serializer, Registry, defineMDMX, ContentProvider contract (v2: deletions in the change set, binary reads)
- [packages/project](packages/project): `mdmx.config.*` schema and loading (json + mjs), environment/mode resolution, registry loading
- [packages/studio](packages/studio): Component Studio — template model, validation, registry merge, TSX eject, `/react` template renderer
- [packages/cli](packages/cli): `mdmx init` (scaffold), `mdmx generate` (registry + component maps + bound server helpers + studio CSS), `mdmx check` (content lint + stale-registry detection), `mdmx dev` (watch)
- [packages/editor](packages/editor): registry→ProseMirror schema, mdast⇄ProseMirror converters, React editor under `/react`
- [packages/next](packages/next): route handlers, LocalProvider, entry readers, sessions, `AuthStrategy` seam, `/render` for public pages
- [packages/dashboard](packages/dashboard): the drop-in CMS mounted at `/mdmx`
- [packages/provider-github](packages/provider-github): atomic multi-file commits via the GitHub Git Data API with conflict detection

## Examples

- [examples/demo-next](examples/demo-next): complete runnable Next.js app on the current recipe (`pnpm dev:next`)
- [examples/demo](examples/demo): minimal consumer project for CLI exercises
- [examples/editor-playground](examples/editor-playground): Vite harness for editor UI work
